description: Java class 'Netstat' that reads system network connection information from /proc filesystem, parsing /proc/net/tcp, /proc/net/udp, and /proc/net/raw to list active network connections with details such as protocol, addresses, ports, and status.

classes.name: Netstat
classes.description: Main class providing methods to retrieve active network connections by reading /proc filesystem.

classes.name: Netstat.Connection
classes.description: Inner class representing a network connection with properties like protocol, addresses, ports, status, process info.

methods.name: getConnections
methods.description: Reads /proc/net/tcp, /proc/net/udp, and /proc/net/raw to list active network connections.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal IP address from /proc to dotted decimal notation.

methods.name: getInt16
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string to an integer.
